production.note: US model years 2009-2016 (owner decision, 8 October 2026). First: Edmunds lists the 2009 V8 Vantage with a '4.7 L' engine and '420 hp @ 7,300 rpm'; the 2006-2008 cars are the 4.3-litre record. Last: Edmunds' 2016 page still lists '2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 6M)' and '(7AM)' (edmunds-v8-vantage-2016), and Cars.com's 2016 V8 Vantage page lists the '2dr Cpe' at '420 hp' and 'Base Curb Weight 3,595 lbs' (carscom-v8-vantage-2016). Excluded: the V8 Vantage S (its own record), the V8 Vantage Roadster (sold under its own name), and the separately named N420 (2011-2012) and GT (2015-2016; Edmunds lists 'GT 2dr Coupe' on its 2015 and 2016 pages, edmunds-v8-vantage-2015) trims. UK build of the 4.7 began in 2008 (automobile-sportive: 'V8 Vantage 4.7 (2008 - )').

body.note: Cars.com: '2dr Cpe', '2-door'. The V8 Vantage Roadster is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

aspiration.note: Inferred: 4.7-litre V8 described with no turbocharger or supercharger.

transmission.note: From Edmunds' style lists (database). 2011: '2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 6M)' and '2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 6AM)'; 2012: '2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 7AM)' (edmunds-v8-vantage-2012); 2014 and 2016: '6M' and '7AM' (edmunds-v8-vantage-2014, edmunds-v8-vantage-2016). The automated manuals are Aston's Sportshift (6-speed) and Sportshift II (7-speed). automobile-sportive: '6 manuelle ou robotisée'.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (databases; no Aston Martin page or magazine panel for the 4.7 coupe was found). Quote (Cars.com, 2014 V8 Vantage 2dr Cpe): "Horsepower 420 hp". Edmunds 2009 (style shown is the Roadster, same engine): "Horsepower | 420 hp @ 7,300 rpm" (edmunds-v8-vantage-2009). automobile-sportive (Sébastien Dupuis, European car): "Puissance maxi (ch à tr/mn): 420 à 7000" (automobile-sportive-v8-vantage-4-7); that is 420 metric ch (PS), about 414 hp, so it corroborates the European rating rather than the US hp figure. Cars.com 2016 2dr Cpe also gives '420 hp' (carscom-v8-vantage-2016). Same rating in every year 2009-2016.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (databases, with a named-author page giving the same figure). Coupe. Quote (iSeeCars, 2009 V8 Vantage): "2dr Coupe" "Curb Weight 3595 lbs". Cars.com 2014 2dr Cpe: "Base Curb Weight 3,595 lbs" (carscom-v8-vantage-2014-coupe); iSeeCars 2014: 2dr Coupe 3595 lbs (iseecars-v8-vantage-2014); Cars.com 2016 2dr Cpe: "Base Curb Weight 3,595 lbs" (carscom-v8-vantage-2016). 3,595 lb = 1,630 kg; automobile-sportive (Sébastien Dupuis) gives "Données constructeur (kg): 1630" for the European V8 Vantage 4.7 (automobile-sportive-v8-vantage-4-7). The databases do not say which transmission. The earlier conflict (Edmunds 3,770 lb) was the Roadster: Edmunds 2009/2014 show 'Roadster 2dr Convertible' at 'Curb weight | 3,770 lbs.'

provisionalNote: Power (420 hp) rests on Cars.com and Edmunds (databases), with automobile-sportive (European car, 420 metric ch, about 414 hp) close. Weight (3,595 lb) rests on iSeeCars and Cars.com (databases), with automobile-sportive's 1,630 kg 'manufacturer data' (European) matching; transmissions rest on Edmunds' style lists. An Aston Martin US press kit or brochure, or a major magazine specification panel (Evo, Autocar, Car and Driver, Road & Track, MotorTrend) for the 4.7-litre V8 Vantage coupe, would replace them.
